Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1163108. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to compound_structures via molregno. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
